title: CSS Clamp Generator
description: Generate fluid clamp() typography and spacing — the exact math from your min/max sizes and viewport range, with a live demo.
howto: Enter the minimum and maximum size (px) you want.
Enter the viewport range (e.g. 360px to 1280px) the fluid scaling should cover.
Copy the generated clamp() rule and watch it scale live in the demo box.

faqs.a: clamp(min, preferred, max) picks a fluid middle value that scales with the viewport but never goes below min or above max — perfect for responsive type.

faqs.q: How is the middle value computed?
faqs.a: Linear interpolation: slope = (maxSize − minSize) / (maxVw − minVw), then preferred = intercept + slope × 100vw. The math is exact, not an approximation.

faqs.q: Should I use px or rem?
faqs.a: Use rem for accessibility (it respects user font-size settings). The toggle converts your px values using a 16px root.
